findings.trigger: Valid saved/runtime mode switches known expansion, GameData rejects merged catalog reload.
findings.owner: GameModes.active_mode; ContentLayers enabled/merged; GameData loaded/catalog; PlayerState game_mode_id
findings.observed: Commits active_mode, each enabled package and its signal, PlayerState.game_mode_id before GameData.load_database; ignores false, returns true.
findings.expected: Success only after accepted catalog; failed reload leaves one coherent previous state or explicit unavailable state.

evidence.fact: mode and profile commit before ignored catalog result
failure sets unloaded and returns false

findings.unproved: Native fault injection/visual UI impact not run. Premature mutation and masked false are proven by source.
findings.fix: Existing owners implement candidate prepare/validate then atomic publish; restore old mode/expansion and avoid emitted signal on failure, or fail closed with save blocked if recovery unavailable.
findings.tests: Inject real malformed merged skill/category after valid mode change; assert failure propagation, no early signal, old mode/package/profile preserved, recover later without duplicate save.

findings.trigger: Non-later valid package enable changes merged data; GameData.load_database returns false. Later settings branch must be separately classified.
findings.owner: RuntimeServices API, ContentLayers package, GameData publication, PlayerState save
findings.observed: Facade mutates ContentLayers first then ignores false for nonlater and returns changed=true. Later branch directly calls PlayerState.set_later_content_enabled which commits signal/save without independent reload gate.
findings.expected: Caller's declared success requires correct authoritative consumer acceptance and unambiguous later-only visibility contract.

evidence.fact: ignores reload status and returns changed
later branch profile change and save
later package settings activation without data resource

findings.unproved: No direct UI caller found under ordinary static grep; dynamic API consumer unknown; later-only reload semantics not settled. Nonlater false masking is source-proven.
findings.fix: Return structured accepted/failed result; stage catalog-bearing package before signaling and commit. For later-only visibility explicitly verify profile/save readiness and avoid adding guessed second catalog reload.
findings.tests: Isolated nonlater bad data and later before/after READY, save failure, idempotent toggle, clean signal/count and no content drift.

findings.trigger: Previously valid saved profile mode is valid but merged expansion reload fails; invalid saved mode fallback classic also rejects.
findings.owner: PlayerState loaded profile and save eligibility; GameModes and GameData own catalog mode
findings.observed: last_load_result is marked successful on JSON read; load_save publishes level/profession/mode, ignores apply_mode failure/fallback, mutates experience/inventory/equipment, may call migration _commit_save; select_character trusts last_load_result and returns true.
findings.expected: Validate entire profile and catalog before public mutation; return failure, block save and preserve old character/mode on reload refusal.
chain: later restore and possible migration save

evidence.fact: mode failure ignored while restoring fields

findings.unproved: No real bad-catalog read execution this B08. Failure propagation gap proven by source.
findings.fix: Detached profile/mode/skill preflight with existing unique owners, then commit state and only then optional save; failure sets last_load_result false and save-block, rolls back or keeps old owner safely, never silent classic fallback for transient failure.
findings.tests: Valid save + damaged merged catalog, invalid mode and failed classic fallback; inspect memory, save bytes, no early signal, no scene launch, post-repair successful recovery.

findings.trigger: Reload fails after earlier public database/maps assignments; a consumer invokes getters without checking GameData.is_loaded().
findings.owner: GameData sole loader and public index owner
findings.observed: load_database clears loaded then assigns maps/database/items/skills before all validation. Getters read current indexes without own readiness guard. Failure can leave partial or mixed cached data accessible if caller ignores readiness.
findings.expected: No partially published authority on failed reload; unavailable until fully validated or preserve atomic previous index.

evidence.fact: public arrays populated before possible failing authority validation
loaded true only after final validation
map getter returns index without ready check
item getter reads cache without ready check

findings.unproved: No fixed-source UI call with concurrent failed reload was dynamically demonstrated; native55 proves unloaded, not every getter consumer.
findings.fix: Stage new public data in private candidate and atomically promote; or enforce loaded gate on all public readers. Coordinate with single ContentLayers owner, no shadow source.
findings.tests: Force every post-map catalog failure, assert no mixed getters, PlayerVisual/feature/UI hold stable, full valid recovery.

findings.trigger: Valid profile document with bad skill_progression snapshot that rejects after public fields were assigned.
findings.observed: Fields level, profession, mode, inventory, equipment and warehouse may mutate before load_snapshot failure; last_load_result false and select_character only resets active_profile_id.
findings.expected: Failed character load must not expose partial replacement or allow stale state use/save.

evidence.fact: skill progression checked after public inventory and equipment mutation
failed selection resets profile id only

findings.unproved: The failure can be injected statically but visual exposure in CharacterSelect not demonstrated.
findings.fix: Prevalidate skill progression detached from live PlayerState and commit once all hard gates pass; otherwise restore complete previous profile snapshot and blocked status.
findings.tests: Disposable valid-profile/invalid-skill identity with existing loaded character, assert old fields unchanged and no save or shared warehouse mutation.
